results.criterion: The file is a single HTML document with inline or CDN CSS and JS and no build step
results.note: One document with inline <style> and <script>, 29,677 bytes; the only external reference is the Google Maps link, and there are no build artefacts.

results.criterion: The page has a menu section listing items with a price shown for each (real or marked placeholder)
results.note: #menu has 6 .menu-row items, each with a .ph 'Price in INR to be added'; a note says the rows are stand-ins.

results.criterion: The page has an opening-hours section with every day of the week listed (real or marked placeholder)
results.note: #hours table lists Monday to Sunday, each with a .ph 'Hours to be added'.

results.criterion: The page has a where-to-find-us section naming Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with an address and a map link or embed (address marked placeholder if unknown)
results.note: #find-us has 'Indiranagar, Bengaluru', a .ph street address and a Maps search link. The link searches the area, not the shop, and a page note says so.

results.criterion: The page has a pre-order-for-pickup form where a visitor picks items and quantities, enters name, phone and pickup time, and gets an order summary on submit; the order destination is a marked placeholder
results.note: #orderForm builds qty rows from the menu and has required name, tel and time inputs. The submit handler renders a summary and an 'Order destination' .ph; the mechanical check found no JS errors.

results.criterion: The page has a beans-and-farms section describing the beans and their farms (farm details marked placeholder if unknown)
results.note: #beans has 3 cards; bean name, roast, farm and region are all .ph, and a note says they are stand-ins.

results.criterion: The page has a loyalty-card explainer stating buy 9, get the 10th free
results.note: #loyalty contains the text 'The rule: buy 9, get the 10th free.' and a 10-space card graphic (9 numbered, 1 'Free').

results.criterion: The file has a viewport meta tag and responsive CSS rules with a mobile layout
results.note: Has <meta name=viewport content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>, base mobile-first CSS and an @media (min-width:768px) block.

results.criterion: Every placeholder is visibly marked in the page text, and none is presented as fact
results.note: All unknown facts use .ph (dashed amber box with a 'Placeholder:' prefix added by CSS). I found no invented prices, hours, address, contact details or farm names.

results.criterion: Navigation links to each section work as in-page anchors
results.note: Mechanical check: broken_in_page_links is empty. Nav hrefs #menu, #hours, #find-us, #beans, #loyalty and #preorder match section ids.

extra_issues.criterion: Standard: mobile-first, usable at 360px width, no horizontal scroll
extra_issues.note: Mechanical check: phone 360px overflow_px = 10 (desktop 1280px = 0). The cause is not identified, and body overflow-x:hidden may be masking it.
